tools.name: jsn_bug_guidance
tools.description: How to file a JSN bug. Returns existing GitHub issue chooser; never creates or posts an issue.

tools.name: jsn_docs_search
tools.description: Search public guidance. source=jsn searches existing JSN feature catalog (not ServiceNow reference); source=servicenow uses hosted public ServiceNow docs API. No instance access.

tools.name: jsn_feature_request_guidance
tools.description: How to request a JSN feature. Returns existing GitHub issue chooser; never creates or posts an issue.

tools.name: jsn_install_guidance
tools.description: How to install JSN. Instructions only; never executes commands. Choose stable/dev explicitly.

tools.name: jsn_remove_guidance
tools.description: How to uninstall global npm JSN. Instructions only; never deletes profiles, credentials, caches, or agent skills.

tools.name: jsn_update_guidance
tools.description: How to update JSN preserving stable/dev channel. Instructions only; cannot inspect local installation. Choose the installed channel unless intentionally switching.
